headline: Zambia Seals Courts Mid-Petition Clock
deck: Supreme and Constitutional Court gates in Lusaka were closed on 24 August. No Mundubile or NRPUP registry number had surfaced by the freeze. Article 269 counts 24 August as day six of seven. The Judiciary’s 2026 guide says there is no time extension.
body: Electoral Commission chair Mwangala Zaloumis declared Hakainde Hichilema president-elect at 02:41 CAT on 18 August [E1]. Article 269 of the Constitution excludes the declaration date when a period is counted in days, so 19 August is day one and 25 August is day seven [E2]. The Judiciary’s 2026 presidential-election disputes guide says a petition is due within seven days after the date of declaration, and that there is no time extension [E3]. Monday 24 August is day six on that arithmetic, not the last day [E2][E3].

The Supreme Court premises in Lusaka, which also house the Constitutional Court, were closed on 24 August. Reuters reported a Judiciary memorandum telling staff not to report for work that day, and that all gates were closed with police inside [E4]. The memorandum itself is not on the Judiciary website, so its signature, hours and nationwide scope are not established from a primary scan [E3][E4]. Ordinary election-period Registry hours in the 2026 guide are 08:30–18:00 CAT [E3].

No Constitutional Court registry or cause number for a Mundubile or NRPUP presidential petition had appeared by 23:11 UTC [E3][E4]. Chishala Kateka said the alliance was trying to ensure the petition was filed, which is not a lodgment [E4]. Constitutional Court Rules allow a document to be filed electronically and treat an electronically filed petition as an official record as of the time it is received [E5]. No 24 August notice proved that the e-filing system was accepting presidential petitions while the gates were shut [E3][E5].

Closure does not, on the published texts, stop the clock. The Rules allow extensions except where time is specifically limited by the Constitution [E5]. Article 269 is that limit [E2]. Whether a registry number is published by 25 August 23:59 CAT is the settlement test already on the ledger [E3][E4].
